title: Record the six measured Lean gate surfaces a plan must name before it is written
description: Record, in the lean extension's plan-authoring gate-collision guidance, six gate surfaces measured across two Lean implementation runs that no plan named in advance and that each blocked a commit until repaired at implement time: typst-sync-check.sh Check 2 staleness on typst/generated/status.typ; check-metalogic-cycles.sh assertion B asserting upward-import-set EQUALITY against a frozen allowlist and failing on surplus; check-module-invariants.sh C26's non-trailing-underscore rule on def/abbrev names; the package longFile 1500-line ceiling and its baselining convention; the show-tactic lint under --wfail; and C5's module-path regex being unable to distinguish declaration names from module paths.

title: Stop one low-specificity shared path from producing duplicate-of-open, and settle Component 7 under /orchestrate
description: Two changes to the task-creation pipeline, one mechanical and one contractual. Mechanical: tune audit-task-proposals.sh's duplicate-of-open predicate so a single low-specificity shared path (a catch-all README) cannot alone produce that verdict at a low semantic score. Contractual: state in the Multi-Task Creation Standard's Component 7 how foreground user confirmation resolves when task filing happens autonomously inside an /orchestrate dispatch whose own task description pre-authorizes it.
